patch_resolves_note: The fixed execution reaches the protected eXIf copy path on the original PoC and satisfies the root aliasing obligation (`post_idat_body_ready.data_ptr == post_idat_body_ready.ctx_data_ptr`) while remaining clean.
verification_limitations: The selected root-to-sink carry invariant `I-DATA-PTR-CARRIES-TO-EXIF-COPY` did not verify on the vulnerable side: the indeterminate local pointer `data` produced a different runtime value when observed at the root site versus the later executed sink, so only the root criterion and sink observation are retained here as actually verified invariants.

nodes.description: At the eXIf copy sink, the source pointer consumed by the `memcpy()` path is not the current chunk payload buffer.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `exif_copy.copy_src_ptr=(nil)` and `exif_copy.copy_payload_ptr=0x6060000000bb`, so the sink-side source pointer differs from `ctx->data`.

root_cause_criterion.description: Immediately before the post-IDAT body is consumed on the eXIf path, local pointer `data` must already be initialized from the current chunk payload buffer (`ctx->data`) so the later ancillary copy reads from the intended bytes.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: In the vulnerable original trace the protected `exif_copy` event executes with `post_idat_body_ready.data_ptr=0x2c1feb80` and `post_idat_body_ready.ctx_data_ptr=0x6060000000b3`, so the predicate is violated. In the fixed original trace the same protected event executes genuinely with both operands equal to `0x6060000000b3`.
